title: Why are people mean on Twitter? - Smarter Every Day 214
summary: Destin Sandlin of Smarter Every Day examines how bad actors and bots use Twitter, drawing on the released Russian IRA dataset and interviews. It asks why interactions on the platform turn hostile.
why: Cited in discussions of platform manipulation and eroding institutional trust, though mentions are mostly passing references.

quote.text: Destin Sandlin explores how YouTube, Twitter, and Facebook are being used as a sort of vanguard in a meta-game to undermine our trust
